title: Operation “Fish Food”: Russia-origin content farm activity
summary: OpenAI banned accounts linked to the Rybar network, some of which likely originated in Russia, that used AI to support multilingual influence activity across websites and social platforms.
body: OpenAI banned accounts linked to the Rybar network, some of which likely originated in Russia, that used AI to support multilingual influence activity across websites and social platforms.
summaryZh: OpenAI封禁了与Rybar网络相关的账户，这些账户利用AI进行多语言舆论影响活动。该案例展示了AI技术在复杂信息操纵中的潜在风险。
